summary: Fixed three bugs: HUD height display freezing at 10m+, spring pads launching weakly instead of using SPRING velocity, and crumbling platforms remaining solid after falling.

bugs.title: Not a bug: missed the first jump and fell at 0 m
bugs.evidence: 0:00-0:03 jumped right off the starting platform and missed platform 43, falling into the void.

bugs.title: HUD height counter stops updating at 10 meters and above
bugs.evidence: In updateHud(), `if (h !== shownH && h < 10)` prevents #hHeight from updating once height reaches 10.

bugs.title: Spring platforms barely bounce the player instead of launching them
bugs.evidence: In land(), `if (pl.type === "spring") { p.vy = JUMP * 0.4; ... }` sets vy to 5 (max height ~0.39m) instead of `SPRING` (22), making the 4.5-6m gap after a spring impossible.

bugs.title: Crumbling platforms stay solid and active at their original height after falling
bugs.evidence: In updatePlatforms(), when `pl.crumbleT > 0.55`, `pl.falling = true` moves `pl.g.position.y = pl.fallY` downward, but `pl.active` stays `true` and `pl.y` stays unchanged, so the player keeps standing on thin air.

edits.find: if (h !== shownH && h < 10) { shownH = h; hHeight.textContent = h; }
edits.replace: if (h !== shownH) { shownH = h; hHeight.textContent = h; }
edits.why: Fix: allow HUD height counter to update at 10m and above.

edits.find: if (pl.crumbleT > 0.55) { pl.falling = true; sfx.crack(); burst(pl.x, pl.y, pl.z, 10, 0.8); }
edits.replace: if (pl.crumbleT > 0.55) { pl.falling = true; pl.active = false; sfx.crack(); burst(pl.x, pl.y, pl.z, 10, 0.8); }
edits.why: Fix: deactivate crumbling platform when it breaks and starts falling so it no longer supports the player in mid-air.

edits.find:
if (pl.type === "spring") {
        p.vy = JUMP * 0.4; p.springing = true; p.sq = 0.55;
edits.replace:
if (pl.type === "spring") {
        p.vy = SPRING; p.springing = true; p.sq = 0.55;
edits.why: Fix: use SPRING velocity when landing on a spring platform instead of JUMP * 0.4.

summary: Fixed the player character facing backward opposite to its movement direction.

bugs.title: Player character faces backward when moving
bugs.evidence: The player mesh has its eyes and cheeks on the local +Z face (z = 0.41) and leans toward +Z when running, but updateVisuals computes target yaw as Math.atan2(-p.vx, -p.vz), rotating local +Z toward (-vx, -vz) opposite to movement.

bugs.title: Not a bug: fell off the first jump in playtest
bugs.evidence: In step 2-4 the jump was released after 600ms while jumping toward platform 47 and missed the landing.

edits.why: Fix: rotate the player's +Z front face toward the velocity vector instead of opposite to it.

summary: Fixed an uncaught TypeError when collecting a gem that crashed and froze the game loop before updating the HUD.

bugs.title: Collecting a gem throws TypeError reading 'position' of null and freezes the game loop
bugs.evidence: In updatePlayer, pl.gem is set to null immediately before logEvent reads pl.gem.position.y, throwing 'Cannot read properties of null (reading position)' at step 9 and halting requestAnimationFrame.

edits.find:
pl.g.remove(pl.gem); pl.gem = null; gems++;
          logEvent("gem", { platform: pl.id, total: gems, height: pl.gem.position.y });
edits.why: Fix: clear pl.gem after logging its position so collecting a gem does not throw a null dereference error and freeze the game.
